newsitem.title: GREECE: FORECAST-Greek June inflation seen at 5.4 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Greek June inflation seen at 5.4 pct y/y.

text.p: Greece's consumer price inflation will be unchanged at 5.4 percent year-on-year in June, bankers and economists predicted in an informal Reuters poll.
Fifteen bankers and economists participated in the informal poll which produced a mean forecast of 5.4 percent, the same as the median. Forecasts ranged from 5.3 percent to 5.5 percent.
Greece's CPI-based inflation is expected to be released later this week or at the beginning of next week. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
